title: The Leading AI Company Is Losing Billions a Year
hook: Leaked, audited financials reportedly show OpenAI bleeding billions of dollars a year. Its revenue is growing fast — but the cost of building AI is growing faster.
key_points: Leaked documents described as audited accounts reportedly show OpenAI losing billions a year.
Revenue is rising quickly, but it's dwarfed by research, computing, and other expenses.
Building and running frontier AI — chips, data centers, talent — is staggeringly expensive.
'Leading the AI race' and 'running a sound business' are not the same thing.
content_html: For all the talk of an AI gold rush, one of its biggest names is reportedly losing money at a remarkable clip. Leaked documents — described as audited financial accounts — suggest OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, is losing billions of dollars a year, according to Ars Technica.
extra_html:
The striking part isn't that OpenAI spends a lot — everyone knew that — but that its fast-growing revenue is still dwarfed by its costs: research and development, the enormous computing bills behind training and running models, and other expenses. Money is coming in quickly, and going out even faster.

For anyone trying to make sense of the AI moment, it's a useful counterweight to the hype. Being the most talked-about company, or having the most advanced model, doesn't automatically mean the business underneath is sound — the economics of frontier AI are still very much unproven. Treat the specific figures as reported rather than company-confirmed; Ars Technica has the details.

related.title: Hype or Real?
related.hook: AI coverage swings between 'this changes everything' and 'it's all a bubble.' The truth is usually in between — and a few questions help you judge any big AI claim for yourself.

related.title: Who Controls AI?
related.hook: The most powerful AI models are built by a handful of giant companies, because training them costs a fortune. Who holds that power — and whether 'open' AI can balance it — shapes everything.

flashcards.prompt: What did the leaked OpenAI financials reportedly reveal?

choices.text: Revenue is growing, but it's dwarfed by research and other costs — so the company loses billions a year
The company is hugely profitable with no major costs
OpenAI has stopped earning any money at all

flashcards.explanation_html: Per the reporting, OpenAI's revenue is rising fast — but spending on research, computing, and other expenses is far higher, leaving billions in annual losses.

flashcards.prompt: Why isn't 'leading the AI race' the same as being profitable?
flashcards.back_html: Building and running frontier AI — chips, data centers, talent — is enormously expensive. A company can dominate technically while still losing money fast.
